name: CSV to HTML Table
summary: Convert CSV into a clean HTML table with escaped cells and optional accessibility markup.
description: Paste CSV and get ready-to-embed HTML with thead/tbody sections, optional caption, column alignment, and scope attributes on header cells. Cell values are HTML-escaped for safe output.

faqs.question: Is the HTML escaped?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ampersands, angle brackets, and quotes in cell values are escaped so the table is safe to embed.

faqs.question: Can I use a custom delimiter?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose comma, semicolon, tab, or pipe delimiters.

faqs.question: What if my CSV has no header row?
faqs.answer: Uncheck “First row is header” to auto-generate Column 1, Column 2, and so on.
